BH.remark:

CD.remark: Running serial number for 'Challan Detail' records in a batch. Should start with 1

CD.remark: Count of total number of 'Deductee Detail Records' within e-TDS statement. Value Should be >= 0

CD.remark: Value should be "N". In cases where no tax has been deposited in bank, value should be "Y" (applicable in case of NIL return)

CD.name: Challan Updation Indicator (Not applicable)
CD.remark: No value should be specified

CD.name: Total tax Deducted
CD.remark: Mention the amount of "Income Tax" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

CD.name: Total Interest
CD.remark: Mention the amount of "Interest" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

CD.name: Total fee
CD.remark: Mention the amount of "Fee" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

CD.name: Total Penalty/ Others
CD.remark: Mention the amount of "Penalty" out of the 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value.

CD.name: Total of Deposit Amount as per Challan/Total Amount adjusted through Book Adjustment (Total of values in B+C+D+E)
CD.remark:
Mention the amount of 'Total tax deposited' through Challan. No fractional portion is allowed in this field (value should be integer) , I.e. value "1000.50" will not be allowed, whereas value "1000.00" will be considered to be valid value. 
Value in this field should be equal to total of values in column numbers B, C, D, E.

In case of challan (i.e. value under field 13 is C), value in this field should be greater than or equal to:
Total tax deposited amount (field no. 25 of all deductee details mapped to corresponding challan) + Interest allocation (field no. 24 of challan details) + Other allocation (field no. 25 of challan details) + Fee amount (field no. 10 of challan details)

In case of transfer voucher (i.e. value under field 13 is B), value in this field should be greater than or equal to:
Total tax deposited amount (field no. 25 of all deductee details mapped to corresponding challan) + Interest allocation (field no. 24 of challan details) + Other allocation (field no. 25 of challan details)

CD.name: Mode of payment of tax (by way of challan/by way of book adjustment)
CD.remark:
Allowed values C or B
If Transfer Voucher Number is provided this is mandatory and only allowed value is 'B'. If Bank Challan Number is provided , then mention value as "C". For a Nil statement no value to be provided.
Value 'C' to be provided, if values under field no. 15 of DD details are '1059', '1034', '1038' or '1061'.

CD.remark: No value should be specified

CD.name: BSR Code/ Form 24G Receipt Number
CD.remark:
In case TDS deposited by 
1) Challan:BSR Code of the receiving branch
2) Book Adjustment: Quote seven digit receipt number provided by AO. Applicable for govt. deductor/ collector where TDS is deposited by book entry. 
3) No value to be quoted in case of Nil Statement (value in field "NIL Challan Indicator" field is "Y").

CD.name: Last Bank Challan No/DDO Serial Number ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
CD.remark: No value should be specified

CD.name: Bank Challan No/DDO Serial Number
CD.remark:
Challan Number issued by Bank if value in field G is C
DDO Serial Number if value in column G is B
 Applicable to both Govt and Non Govt, Non-Nil statements. No value is required to be provided in case of a NIL return (I.e. the cases in which the value in field 'NIL Challan Indicator' is "Y").

CD.name: Last Date of 'Bank Challan No / DDO Serial Number' ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
CD.remark: No value should be specified

CD.name: Date of 'Bank Challan / Transfer Voucher' (DDMMYYYY)
CD.remark:
Date of payment of tax to Govt. It can be any date on or after 1st April of immediate previous financial year for which the return is prepared. Value should be equal to last date of respective quarter if the value in field "NIL Challan Indicator" is "Y". 
Date of 'Bank Challan / Book Adjustment' should be within the respective quarter for which statement is being filed, in case of minor head code value selected under field no. 23 is '100'. Also this date has to be on or before date present under field 'Date on which Amount paid / Credited' field no. 19 of DD record (which is mapped to this challan with minor head code value '100')

CD.name: Last Total of Deposit Amount as per Challan ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
CD.remark: No value should be specified

CD.name: Total Tax Deposited Amount as per Collectee annexure (Total Sum of column no. L) for the specified challan
CD.remark: Mention the sum of 'Deductee Deposit Amount' of the underlying Deductee Records

CD.name: Total Tax Deducted Amount as per Deductor annexure (Total sum of Column no. J) for the specified challan
CD.remark: Total sum of tax collected of the deductee details for the respective Challan

CD.name: Minor Head of Challan
CD.remark:
Mention value as marked on challan - refer Annexure 7 for minor head
For Minor head code 100:
If DD details are having section code '1059', '1034', '1038' or '1061', then minimum 1 deductee should be there for challans having minor head code 100.

CD.remark: Mention interest allocation. Only integer values are allowed. The value of 1000 should be represented as 1000.00 in this field. Mention value as provided in field no. 9 of CD details.

DD.name: Last deductee PAN ( Used for Verification) (Not applicable)
Deductee's PAN
DD.remark:
PAN of the Employee. If available should be Valid PAN Format. There may be Employees who have not been issued PAN however who have applied for a PAN and have given adequate declaration to the deductor indicating the same. In such cases, deduction schedule in the statement will not reflect PAN and instead state PAN Ref. Number for the Employee. The deductor will however have to mention ‘PANAPPLIED’ in place of PAN. If the Employee is not sure of the PAN format he will have to mention 'PANINVALID'. However if the Employee has not given any declaration, deductor will have to mention ‘PANNOTAVBL’ in place of PAN. 

For section codes '1059', '1034', '1038' or '1061', no default PAN values should be allowed under this field. That means default PAN values in case of non-availablity of valid PAN ('PANNOTAVBL', 'PANAPPLIED', 'PANINVALID') will not be allowed for these sections.

DD.remark: Mention the Name of the deductee.

Date of payment / Credited (dd/mm/yyyy)
DD.remark: Date on which Amount paid/ Credited /Debited to deductee. The value under the “Date of Payment / Date on which Amount Collected / Debited” field shall fall within the quarter and financial year to which the statement pertains·

DD.name: Amount Paid/ Credited
DD.remark: Mention the Amount paid to deductee. Value should always be greater than 0.00

DD.name: Amount of cash withdrawal in excess of Rs. 1 crore as referred to in section 393(3) [Table: Sl. No. 5] (in case of person other than cooperative society)
DD.remark: Mandatory to mention value under this field only when value under field Section Code (field no. 15) of DD records is "section 393(3), i.e. section code 1065", else no value should be specified.

DD.name: Amount of cash withdrawal which is in excess of Rs. 3 Crore for cases covered by section 393(3) [Table: Sl. No. 5] (in case of co- operative societies)
DD.remark: Mandatory to mention value under this field only when value under field Section Code (field no. 15) of DD records is "section 393(3), i.e. section code 1064", else no value should be specified.

DD.name: Total Tax Deducted
DD.remark:
Decimal with precision value 2 is allowed. 
In case value present under field 15 is 1059', '1034', '1038' or '1061', then value under this field should be 0.00.

DD.name: Total Tax Deposited
DD.remark:
Decimal with precision value 2 is allowed.

DD.name: Last total Tax deducted (Used for Verification) (Not Applicable)
Date of deduction (dd/mm/yyyy)
DD.remark: Date of tax deduction. Mandatory if 'Total tax deducted' is greater than Zero (0.00) . No value needs to be specified if 'Total Tax Deducted' is Zero (0.00) . Date to be mentioned in DDMMYYYY format. Also, this date should not be less than the relevant quarter. E.g. If the statement is being prepared for Q2 of Tax Year 2026-27, then date of deduction should be greater than or equal to 01/07/2026.

DD.name: Rate at which Tax Deducted
DD.remark:
Rate at which Tax is deducted, with decimal precision of 4 point. E.g. if the rate is 2 then the same should be mentioned as 2.0000. If value in field 'Total tax collected' is 0.00 then rate at which tax deducted should be 0.0000
In case value present under field 15 is 1059', '1034', '1038' or '1061', then value under this field should be 0.00.
